svg.title: Phase-2 gate for the routing Skill
svg.desc: Before the routing Skill may decide anything, five conditions must hold: skill booted (met), no rollback (met), at least 500 decisions (224, not met), outcome join rate at least 0.95 (0.98, met), proxy evidence per surface (not yet shown).
